question: What is the negative affect of Japan in 2022?
query: To get the negative affect of Japan in the year 2022, use the following SQL query on PostgreSQL:  ```sql SELECT negative_affect FROM world_happiness_report WHERE country_name = 'Japan' AND year = 2022 LIMIT 1; ``` This will return only one row (as per your requirement) with the negative affect score of Japan in the year 2022, if available.
